name: RuneSchema
description: Core quick settings shared with Helpy through RuneSchema/settings/settings.ini. Cleanup follows its activation choice. Helpy cache, layout and FPS preferences remain in Helpy.

settings.label: Blanket save cleanup (fallback)
settings.tooltip: On: the original broad cleanup across supported local saves at a safe load boundary. Off: selected character/world only. Preview alone never authorizes cleanup. Verified backups are mandatory.

settings.label: Apply cleanup changes at next world entry
settings.tooltip: On: read the saved cleanup choice at the next character/world entry. Off: retain this session's applied policy until restarting Dragonwilds. Changing a setting does not start a background sweep.

settings.label: Save Bypass by default
settings.tooltip: On: prefer bypass. Off: relaxed native loading followed by fallback after native rejection. Keep backups and disable any standalone bypass. This does not repair damaged data.

settings.label: Helpy shortcut
settings.tooltip: Mod Menu edits the same shortcut as Helpy. Restart after changing it here, or use Helpy's Quick Settings for immediate rebinding. Avoid keys already used by the game or another mod.
